scope: Pawn-skeleton templates for detecting and narrating structure trajectory from FEN/PGN positions. Opening family names are metadata only and must not be required for matching.

normalizationConventions.canonicalSide: primary side is represented as White in template coordinates; opposing side is represented as Black
normalizationConventions.colourReverse: To match a Black-primary instance, invert colors and map ranks 1<->8 while preserving files, then swap side roles.
normalizationConventions.fileMirror: Apply a<->h, b<->g, c<->f, d<->e only when allowFileMirror is true and only after colour normalization. Do not merge strategically distinct d-chain/e-chain families by default.
normalizationConventions.rankMirror: Always false for these templates because pawn direction is strategic information.
normalizationConventions.matchingBasis: Use pawns and derived features: pawn presence/absence by square/file, adjacent-file isolation, open/semi-open files, wing pawn counts, locked contacts, and candidate breaks. Piece placement may improve confidence but must not define a structure.
normalizationConventions.unknownPolicy: Return null/unknown when top candidate confidence is below threshold, when sibling candidates are too close, or when central pawn count is too low for the label to remain meaningful.

structures.descriptionShort: A side owns an isolated central d-pawn whose value depends on activity, breaks, and whether the opponent can blockade the square directly in front of it.

corePawnSkeleton: Primary pawn on d4 with no friendly c- or e-file pawn.
Opposing side has access to d5 as the natural blockade square.
filePatterns: c- and e-files are open or semi-open for the primary side more often than not.
The d-file may contain pressure against or from the isolated pawn.
rankPatterns: The pawn is normally on the fourth rank for the primary side; d5 creates a different passed/advanced-pawn state.
centralTensionRules: Do not require a pawn directly facing d4; the defining feature is isolation, not contact.
If a friendly c- or e-pawn reappears through promotion metadata, reject the template.
openOrSemiOpenFileRules: Reward piece-accessible c/e files adjacent to the isolated pawn.
Reward an opponent semi-open d-file aimed at the isolani.
weakSquareRules: The square d5 is a high-value opponent outpost/blockade square.
The square d3 may become a rear weakness after exchanges but is secondary.
typicalPawnBreaks: primary:f2-f4/f4-f5 when kingside play is available
typicalTransformations: isolani->hanging_pawns if a neighbouring pawn pair is created by recapture
isolani->passed_d_pawn after d4-d5 and exchanges
isolani->endgame_liability after major piece trades
